hypothesis.name: CASHCAT round-trip size-curve test
hypothesis.rationale: Measured fact: the verified graph has two WETH–CASHCAT pools, and the menu offers this route as a SIZE_CURVE cell capped at 0.02 WETH. Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: the route may show size-dependent after-gas net behavior. Quote every supplied exact size up to the cap, then select the greatest current after-gas net; do not scale quote outputs. Entry requires the selected quote to meet the 20 bps edge floor and configured gas-safety rule for two consecutive eligible observations. The available evidence does not establish a forward result for this hypothesis.
